deliverables.description: Portrait gameplay with spectral fox, five ordered dice, large controls and separate charms navigation.
Dedicated eight-charm collection with selected charm details; fox portrait removed to recover space.
Four-frame temporal storyboard: Rest, Spirit leads, Body follows, Rejoin. Strong offset demonstrates the effect; idle treatment should be subtler.

prompts.name: portrait-gameplay-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished portrait mobile gameplay concept, tall 9:16 canvas, edge-to-edge game screen without phone hardware bezel. Reference image role: visual reference for the APPROVED HYBRID art direction, fox identity, palette and room; not a layout to crop. Preserve the slim rust-red fox spirit with long vulpine muzzle, tall ears, cream ruff, charcoal forepaws, green waistcoat and ONE large cream-tipped tail. Warm amber wooden roadside house with rain-blue window and amber oil lamp. Layered painted fox/environment with tactile dimensional 3D dice/props. Original fictional folklore. The spirit is physically tangible but emits pale translucent icy blue silhouettes with faint warm yellow cores and broken dissolving edges. Avoid opaque duplicate animals, extra physical heads or limbs, neon outlines, electrical lightning, heavy smoke, horror gore, logos, watermarks.
Recompose specifically for a narrow smartphone. TOP 8%: elegant compact title "THE LAST LANTERN", subheading "STAGE 9 / 25". UPPER 35%: fox behind table, expressive face LARGE enough to read on phone; rain window narrowly left, lamp right. Fox is starting to turn its head toward screen-right: ONE faint pale cyan-blue ghost profile has already turned slightly farther toward the destination, with transparent gold inner light, while the solid head lags; same single animal. One subtle ghost tail ribbon curves just ahead of the solid tail. Keep spirit effects within character region, not across text.
MIDDLE 15%: clean high contrast panel "225 TO CLEAR", small counters "HANDS 2" and "REROLLS 2". LOWER MIDDLE: ONE shallow wide dice tray with EXACTLY FIVE evenly spaced ordered slots and five ivory 3D dice, showing 2,2,2,5,5 left to right. All five dice remain in a SINGLE horizontal row, clear top faces. Fourth die slightly raised with thin amber selection ring and tiny "REROLL" label. Others unselected.
Under dice, generous readable score card: "FULL HOUSE", "51 x 6 = 306". Small activated charm chip "Quiet Faces  +15 base" visually connects to the score, not a permanent inventory strip.
BOTTOM 20%: large stacked thumb-friendly buttons "REROLL 1 DIE" and "PLAY HAND", then a compact separate navigation button "CHARMS (8)" with token icon. Minimum 24 pixels clear inset from all image edges, comfortable bottom safe area. All text horizontal and crisp, especially buttons. No permanent charm inventory grid anywhere. No event log, no debug IDs, no dialogue paragraphs. Keep world attractive but reduce tabletop clutter, keep room dark behind bright legible controls. Clear separation of spirit portrait, resources, dice, score and buttons. Concept mockup only.

prompts.name: portrait-charms-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: polished portrait mobile CHARM COLLECTION screen, tall 9:16 canvas matching the game's hybrid visual identity. Reference image role: visual reference for the APPROVED HYBRID art direction, fox identity, palette and room; not a layout to crop. Preserve the slim rust-red fox spirit with long vulpine muzzle, tall ears, cream ruff, charcoal forepaws, green waistcoat and ONE large cream-tipped tail. Warm amber wooden roadside house with rain-blue window and amber oil lamp. Layered painted fox/environment with tactile dimensional 3D dice/props. Original fictional folklore. The spirit is physically tangible but emits pale translucent icy blue silhouettes with faint warm yellow cores and broken dissolving edges. Avoid opaque duplicate animals, extra physical heads or limbs, neon outlines, electrical lightning, heavy smoke, horror gore, logos, watermarks.
This is a separate readable collection screen opened from gameplay. View is an overhead wooden table with a deep blue-green felt folio displaying tokens; the rainy room exists only as a very dim top-edge background. Do NOT fill the screen with the fox, do not show dice or gameplay action buttons. TOP header: "YOUR CHARMS", subtitle "8 collected this run". A small top-left back chevron and top-right small "?" icon.
Upper middle: exactly EIGHT large square wood/ceramic charm tiles in TWO ROWS OF FOUR, equal generous touch spacing. All eight are owned, no price tags, no lock icons. Symbols simple and distinct: first two leaves, then moon, ripple, eye, star, branch, sun, diamond. First charm selected, bright subtle pale-blue border; other tiles unselected. No need tiny text under every tile.
Below grid, a spacious detail panel with enlarged selected leaf token and title "Quiet Faces". Exact large readable description on separate lines: "No die shows 1 or 6." / "+15 base score" / "When you play a hand" / "Once per hand". Clear soft cyan status chip: "Ready for this hand". A smaller contextual sentence: "Stays with you for this run." Bottom of card small helper "Tap a charm to inspect it."
BOTTOM: one wide prominent "RETURN TO TABLE" button, comfortable thumb position and bottom safe margin. Do not add equip, sell, buy or remove actions. Crisp legible typography, restrained thin brass borders, large controls, understated blue spirit motes at edges only. Focus on a practical mobile inventory screen, not a decorative poster. All content visible without cropping, no decorative empty lower third.

prompts.name: spectral-motion-study-v1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished animation direction storyboard, landscape 16:9 board with FOUR equally sized panels in one left-to-right row. Reference image role: visual reference for the APPROVED HYBRID art direction, fox identity, palette and room; not a layout to crop. Preserve the slim rust-red fox spirit with long vulpine muzzle, tall ears, cream ruff, charcoal forepaws, green waistcoat and ONE large cream-tipped tail. Warm amber wooden roadside house with rain-blue window and amber oil lamp. Layered painted fox/environment with tactile dimensional 3D dice/props. Original fictional folklore. The spirit is physically tangible but emits pale translucent icy blue silhouettes with faint warm yellow cores and broken dissolving edges. Avoid opaque duplicate animals, extra physical heads or limbs, neon outlines, electrical lightning, heavy smoke, horror gore, logos, watermarks.
Title at top "SPIRIT LEADS, BODY FOLLOWS". This is a temporal sequence of ONE HEAD TURN, not four different characters. Each panel has the exact same locked camera crop of the fox head, shoulders, one forepaw and dark room behind, so pose changes are unambiguous. Four short captions at bottom, exactly "1 / REST", "2 / SPIRIT LEADS", "3 / BODY FOLLOWS", "4 / REJOIN".
Panel 1 REST: opaque physical fox faces screen-left three-quarter view, ghost silhouette perfectly aligned almost invisible.
Panel 2 SPIRIT LEADS: physical fox stays in EXACT same left-facing pose as panel 1; one translucent blue spirit head silhouette rotates ahead toward screen-right, visibly separated 10-15% of head width, pale yellow light within, softly dissolving ears and muzzle, room clearly visible through ghost. This spectral silhouette must visibly anticipate a NEW future pose rather than trail an old pose. Solid fox does not yet turn.
Panel 3 BODY FOLLOWS: opaque physical head has turned halfway toward screen-right; pale-blue spirit profile is already at its final right-facing angle, displaced slightly ahead of the solid head. Thin delicate light between the two, no smeared motion blur.
Panel 4 REJOIN: physical fox now faces screen-right three-quarter view, spirit and body align again with a few fading blue-gold wisps at ears and whiskers. Spirit mostly fades. Clearly recognizable same face, same fur colors, same green waistcoat, same amber room. Strong readable visual distinction between opaque solid fur and transparent ghost form. No extra corporeal heads, no ghost remaining behind the motion, no fire or bright blue flood across entire image. Clean storyboard panels with gutters and readable captions. No UI or dice needed in this animation study.

charmsRevisionPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached portrait charm collection screen. Preserve the hybrid material style, palette, exact charm description, eight-owned-charm count, selected charm identity, and bottom RETURN TO TABLE action. Fix only the layout and remove decorative characters.
REMOVE THE FOX ENTIRELY, including its tail, from this collection screen. Remove the large room vista occupying the upper third. Replace that space with the actual inventory, not blank space. This is an overhead folio/menu, not another portrait of the host.
Composition full tall 9:16 phone screen: compact title YOUR CHARMS with subtitle 8 collected this run occupies top 10%, back arrow top-left. Directly BELOW title at 12% of image height start the grid of eight charm tiles in exactly two rows of four. Grid occupies 12-42% height. Make charm tiles square in a nearly flat overhead view, no severe perspective. First tile selected with soft blue border. All eight symbols distinct: first a leafy sprig, then moon, ripple, eye, star, bare branch, sun, diamond. Remove duplicate leaf tile.
Selected detail card starts at 45% height and fills to 83% height, with generous large readable text. Header Quiet Faces, medium-sized selected leaf charm icon. Exact text: No die shows 1 or 6. / +15 base score / When you play a hand / Once per hand. Cyan status chip Ready for this hand. Small sentence Stays with you for this run.
At 86% small hint Tap a charm to inspect it. Bottom wide RETURN TO TABLE button at 89-96% height. Comfortable safe margin. Rich deep blue-green felt, aged brass, wood edging; room only tiny dim slivers outside folio at edges. NO FOX, no ghost foxes, no new characters, no dice, no duplicate icons, no prices or equip actions. Minimal spirit particles, none crossing text. The result should be a clear beautiful dedicated mobile collection screen with greater usable space than input.
